title: No new entry in the direction of QQQ's last-60-min move (late-chase veto), all accounts; variant B: longs within 0.15% of QQQ's session high / shorts within 0.15% of its low
hypothesis: On a two-way index day the book enters late in the direction the index has just moved and is caught by the turn. 2026-10-19: QQQ -0.42% at 10:04, +0.69% at 11:37 (high), -0.18% at the close. Across Primary, Testing 1 (incl. 132 replayed trades missing from its journal, estimate) and Testing 2, entries on the same side as QQQ's last-60-min move: 169 trades, 40% wins, -0.285R, -$660.78 after costs; all other entries: 635, 57%, -0.055R, +$113.23. Concentrated in longs entered 11:00-13:59 after the rally (T1 longs with the move 22 trades -0.604R -$233.57 at |move| >= 0.3%; T2 longs 30, -0.371R, -$114.73). Variant B (near the index extreme): T2 longs within 0.15% of QQQ HOD 132 trades -0.283R vs 149 others -0.032R, but T1 longs show no difference and Primary shorts near the low did better (+0.019R vs -0.254R).
notes: One session, in-sample, descriptive (about 6 index-context cuts looked at; 0 backtest configurations). Mixed by account: Primary shorts with the move did better (4 trades +0.498R), so the effect may be day-specific. Related but different: bdi1016-dayclass-direction-gate (failed; classifies the day at 10:00/10:30), gb-1019-post-peak-index-guard (idea; blocks entries AGAINST the index after the account peak), nightly-1012-cwt14-long-index-confirm (idea; the opposite direction). Pre-declare on history2y: lookback 30/60/90 min x |move| threshold 0/0.3/0.5% (9 configs + variant B 3 thresholds), costs in, regime split up/down, walk-forward, try-count-scaled t; locked block untouched until a finalist exists.
